## Checklist

- [ ] Follows [docs/policy.md](../docs/policy.md): nothing allowed is hidden or redirected
- [ ] Every new or changed rule has a test (`make check` passes; coverage gates are green)
- [ ] Fixtures hold no personal data
- [ ] `site.yaml` limitations updated if something can't be done
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
